local_edits: settings.tsx marks the active profile's section dirty. scheduler.scopeFor resolves only that profile's syncId; it does not fan out a local mutation to every linked profile document
incoming_documents: engine.applyDocs walks registered documents for every known syncId, ordered by section rank and original response order
linked_storage: Linked profiles read and write the shared settings store. Unlinked profiles have independent settings; inactive profiles are applied through persistence rather than the active UI provider
correction_to_previous_work_notes: Automatically sending each change to every linked profile would add behavior absent from the reference. The actual missing work is full-roster section hydration and correct shared-store projection while retaining per-document revisions and pending intents
native_current_behavior: HarborProfileSync applies home, anime, nav and services only for the active profile. Shared local namespaces already exist, but incoming inactive profile sections are not yet applied
